title: docs(adr): ADR-0144 amendment — a master_detail child follows its parent's currency, and the parent's code locks
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"zhuangjianguo"} -->
_Requested by **Steedos** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb?thread=cmsg_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb4X8uy2GsmYuM9U7iRqKzNt)_

Fixes #31743

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**:只改 ADR-0144 的文字(一个文件,+121/−2)。明细行(master_detail 子对象)的金额可以直接跟随主记录的币种;沿同一条 master_detail 的汇总(summary)按主记录币种允许;主记录一旦有跟随它的明细行(回收站里的也算),它的币种字段就不能再改;但原本为空的币种第一次填写不受锁定(与本位币首次设置同理),再写同一个币种也不算修改。
- **为什么改**:执行你 2026-11-09 对 #31743 的裁决 A(「同意」)。比如一张 EUR 发票,明细行和小计也显示 EUR,不再显示本位币。你要求修订本身二选一:锁定还是级联重算。席位选了锁定。
- **风险与回滚**:不改代码、不发版,只改 ADR 文字。回滚就是 revert 这一个提交。真正的行为变化由 #31910(spec)、#31911(objectql)、#31912(ui)三张子卡实现,它们都被本卡阻塞。
- **先看**:`docs/adr/0144-…md` D2 下的 2026-11-09 修订注(锁定条款、拒绝方式、回收站明细、空币种首次填写放行);D6 下的修订注(汇总允许的边界和执行清单);Open item 14(留给子卡的三个边界情况)。
- **两分钟验证**:`git grep -n "Amended (2026-11-09, #31743)" -- docs/adr/` 应命中 5 处(TL;DR 两处、D2、D6、Consequences);`pnpm check:adr-symbol-anchors` 应为绿。
- **需要你做的**:确认锁定这个选择,然后批准(或合并)本 PR。这是 Tier H,只能由你落地。

## What changes

One file, `docs/adr/0144-multi-currency-record-currency-dated-rates-write-time-home-projection.md`. It follows this ADR's own amendment convention: an `**Amended**` entry on the Status line, and dated notes beside the ruled text, which stays as written. The D2 and D6 notes use ADR-0048's blockquote form (`> **Amended (DATE, #N) — …**`). The TL;DR, D1 and Consequences notes use this record's `*Note (DATE):*` / `*Amended (DATE, #N):*` inline form.

- **Status line**: an `Amended` entry for ruling A, recorded in [`6739066323`](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/issues/31743#issuecomment-6739066323).
- **Provenance**: ruling A amends D2 and D6. The lock is the spec seat's pick under the ruling's condition, recorded in claim [`6739159874`](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/issues/31743#issuecomment-6739159874).
- **TL;DR and D1**: notes beside the two restatements of D2 and D6. D1's quote is ruling text and is not edited.
- **D2 note**: quotes ruling A. `currencyField` may name `MASTER_DETAIL_FIELD.PARENT_CODE_FIELD`, and only through `master_detail`, not `lookup`. Then the **lock**, with the ruling record's condition and the seat's three reasons quoted verbatim. The refusal is `VALIDATION_FAILED` / 400 (the record-write envelope) with one `invalid_value` finding on the parent's code field, the finding D4's lock also carries inside `SETTINGS_VALIDATION`. The lock is read at each write and lifts once no child follows. A child row in the recycle bin still follows its parent, because an ADR-0148 restore writes the row back with no projection. The first setting of a blank code passes, as D4 lets an unset home currency be set. The cascade was not chosen.
- **D6 note**: a `summary` through that same `master_detail` is admitted in the parent's currency. Every other aggregate keeps D6's first bullet. An **execution** block names the current enforcement sites as symbol anchors (`refuseRecordModeKeyMismatch`, `refuseDishonestRecordCurrencyField`, `refuseDishonestHomeAmount`, `recordCurrencyFieldOf` and its readers including `recordCurrencyPairs`, `recordCurrencySummaryRefusal`). It also names the children #31910, #31911 and #31912.
- **Consequences**: two additive admissions and one new refusal on data. The lock is undoable, so it is not a third irreversible step.
- **Open item 14**: three edges that neither the ruling nor the lock decides, left to #31911 and #31910. They are a child that moves to another parent (a lean, not adopted), grouping by the parent path in raw aggregates (grouping by the `master_detail` field itself takes a maintainer ruling), and the code backfill for a parent-held code.

No code, schema, test or changeset. `skip-changeset`: `docs/adr/**` publishes nothing.

## Tests

None. This PR is ADR prose only.

## Acceptance notes

- **LOCK against ADR-0144.** Before writing, I grepped the record for any ruled sentence that keeps a code field editable or asks for a cascade (`code field|cascade|change.*code|edit|lock`). None contradicts the lock. D5 confines rewrites of stored conversions to an explicit recompute, and D4 already locks the home currency.
- **Contract review fixes (head 809f1774).** S1 quotes the ruling record's condition and D6 sentence exactly; S2 counts a binned child as following; S3 sends grouping by the `master_detail` field itself to a maintainer ruling; nits N1–N4 applied.
- **Wording of the seat's first reason.** It is quoted from the claim ("a cascade would re-rate stored history"), not from the dispatch brief ("at a new date's rate"). Under a cascade the child's document date does not move, so the claim's wording is the accurate one.
- **Two readings the amendment states beyond the ruling's words.** The contract review (record 6739836182, PASS) kept both. (1) The first setting of a blank parent code passes the lock, by analogy with D4. (2) A child amount beside a blank parent code meets `ERR_CURRENCY_CODE_REQUIRED` at its own write, since D8 rule 4's explicit code is now the parent's.
